purpose: Localized Quiet Modern design concepts shared by the root README overview, Screenshots section, and product-page hero.

outputs.method: Copy of the approved Chinese concept after removing its outer heading and subtitle.
English localization followed by removal of the outer heading and subtitle with built-in image_gen.
outputs.prompt:
Use case: text-localization.
Asset type: English-language Quiet Modern UI design concept for the toxee README and product page.
Input image: the supplied Chinese Quiet Modern desktop-and-phone board is the edit target.
Primary request: Translate EVERY visible Chinese string into natural, accurate English while preserving the original design, layout, framing, dimensions, typography hierarchy, avatars, icons, mint/teal/white colors, shadows, corner radii, chat bubble alignment and desktop/phone composition. This is a faithful localization, no redesign.
All text must be English except the brand "toxee", numeric times, and emoji. Replace Chinese avatar glyphs with corresponding Latin initials. The desktop and phone must show the same people and identical conversation.
Text replacements:
Top heading "A · Quiet Modern"; subtitle "toxee / Interface style concept".
Current user: "Mia Lin", status "Online".
Desktop navigation: "Chats", "Contacts", "Apps", "Settings". Conversation title: "Chats". Search placeholder: "Search".
Chat list: orange group avatar "WH", group name "Weekend Hikers ⛰️", preview "Ready 🙌", time "09:40".
Blue avatar "L", contact "Leo Chen", preview "See you Saturday 🥾", time "09:37".
Pink avatar "Y", contact "Yuki Su 🌸", preview "I'll bring snacks 🥜", time "08:54".
Green avatar "J", contact "Jack Zhou", preview "Sure, adding you now", time "Yesterday".
Desktop and phone chat header: blue "L" avatar; name "Leo Chen"; status "Online".
Date pill: "Sep 17".
Identical messages in both chat views, in order:
Received: "Hike by the lake this weekend? The larches are turning yellow 🍂" time "09:32".
Sent: "Yes! North loop or lakeside trail?" time "09:33" with delivery tick.
Received: "Lakeside. Meet at the trailhead at 7. Back before the rain." time "09:34".
Sent: "Deal. I'll bring my favorite thermos ☕" time "09:35" with delivery tick.
Received: "Great! I'll send the route tonight 🗺️" time "09:36".
Sent: "See you Saturday 🥾" time "09:37" with delivery tick.
Desktop and phone input placeholder: "Message". Desktop send button: "Send".
Constraints: preserve unread counts 3, 2 and 1, UI icon locations, all panel proportions and phone outline; wrap English strings cleanly within existing bubble boundaries and list rows, reduce font very slightly only where needed, retain readable text. No residual Chinese characters anywhere. No additional labels, features, watermarks, or decorations.

note: Concept art, not running-app screenshots. Captured feature-tour assets under <locale>/<platform>/ remain separate.
